[README.md] The rules were written down before the chase was run, with dated amendments; seven of the eight predicted outcomes written first came true.
[README.md] The median Boomer chase took seven years across nineteen start years; the eleven Millennial chases that finished took a median of twelve, and no Gen Z chase has finished yet.
[data/README.md] Each file below is frozen by its `sha256` hash, which `profile_data.py` checks (run `python3 profile_data.py` from the post folder).
[data/README.md] The script then prints the coverage, with any gaps, of each series the analysis reads, and the cross-checks it runs; the code lists, titles and footnote files are kept for reference.

[data/README.md] FHFA's terms ask for the attribution and the notice: this product uses FHFA data but is neither endorsed nor certified by FHFA. - **Anchors.** The median value of specified owner-occupied homes in the census year the existing-home check is anchored to, and the median value of owner-occupied units in the American Community Survey of the year the chase ends.

[data/README.md] The BLS website answers automated requests with an access-denied page, so every BLS file here is an Internet Archive copy of the official file, and its content matches the archive's own record.

[data/README.md] The final year averages eleven months. - **Prices.** The consumer price index retroactive series using current methods, `R-CPI-U-RS`, annual average, and the CPI-U, `CUUR0000SA0`, as a check. - **Spending.** Consumer Expenditure Surveys, LABSTAT database, means by age of reference person: average annual expenditures, food away from home, entertainment, personal care products and services, and snacks and nonalcoholic beverages bought away from home.
